channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Dr Reddy’s Launches Hevaxin, India’s First Hepatitis E Vaccine Targeting High-Risk Adults Nationwide
item.description: Dr. Reddy’s launches Hevaxin, India’s first DCGI-approved vaccine, to combat the deadly waterborne Hepatitis E virus.

item.title: People of Purpose: How Saurabh Mehrotra’s Youth Dreamers Foundation Is Bridging India’s Scholarship Access Gap
item.description: Saurabh Mehrotra's YDF turns scholarship barriers into opportunities for 35,000 tribal/first-gen youth via funding, counseling, and skilling amid India's low higher education access.

item.title: ₹10 Lakh Job Promise, Real Fraud: How Bihar’s ‘All India Pregnant Job Service’ Exploited the Unemployed
item.description: Bihar Police arrested two accused after uncovering a fake job scam exploiting unemployment and infertility stigma through false promises.

item.title: Patient Finds Dead Insect in Sealed Mouthwash Bought From Hospital Pharmacy in Madhya Pradesh; Probe Launched
item.description: Another public health shocker in Madhya Pradesh has caught everyone's attention after a patient found dead insect in a sealed mouthwash.

item.title: A Visionary Move: Tamil Nadu Govt Launches India’s First Deep Tech Policy Backing 100 Startups
item.description: Tamil Nadu unveils India’s first deep tech policy, aiming to foster innovation, jobs, and socially impactful technology.

item.title: “Murderous Attack”: TN BJP Youth Wing President S.G. Surya Says He and 20+ Party Workers Were Allegedly Attacked After TV Debate
item.description: BJP leaders allege a violent post-debate attack on youth wing members in Chennai, prompting political outrage and a police investigation.

item.title: 10-Minute Delivery, Zero Safety: The Dark Side of India’s Gig Economy
item.description: India’s gig economy exploits delivery workers, prioritizing speed over safety, welfare, and basic human protections.

item.title: Fake ‘All India Pregnant Job’ Scam: Cyber Gang Allegedly Promising ₹10 Lakh to Impregnate Women Busted in Bihar’s Nawada
item.description: Bihar Police arrested multiple accused after a cyber gang allegedly duped young men by promising ₹10 lakh for impregnating women through a fake online scheme.

item.title: In Smog-Hit Delhi NCR, Green Pencil Foundation’s Eco-Friendly Libraries Offer Students Safer Learning Spaces
item.description: As air pollution worsens in Delhi NCR, Green Pencil Foundation's eco-friendly libraries are offering children safer spaces to learn and breathe.

item.title: Delhi High Court Refuses to Stay Government Order on Private School Fee Panels, Extends Time for Compliance
item.description: The Delhi High Court has allowed the school fee regulation law to continue while granting private schools more time to form committees and submit fee proposals.
